subject: NovaLedger — root cause readout and fix plan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@novaledger.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@novaledger.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 18:03:00 -0500
Subject: NovaLedger — preliminary post-incident summary and next steps

Hi Jamie / Priya,

Thank you again for your patience while we completed the internal investigation. I wanted to share a concise readout of what we know so far and the immediate actions we're committing to: 

Summary (high level)
- What happened: Between 2027-01-13 23:40 UTC and 2027-01-14 02:15 UTC a KV-cache inconsistency in the inference layer caused a subset of requests to receive stale prefix state, resulting in truncated or partially coherent generations for approximately 0.6% of NovaLedger calls.
- Customer impact: degraded generation quality and occasional early truncation for transactions-heavy endpoints. No data exfiltration or unauthorized access observed.

Immediate actions completed
- Reconciled affected KV shards and forced a cold-cache rebuild for NovaLedger's dedicated pool.
- Rolled an emergency hotfix to the cache sync state machine.
- Applied a temporary routing rule to divert traffic to a warmed alternate pool while we validated fixes.

Deliverables we will share by EOD tomorrow (2027-01-15)
- Formal root cause readout (PDF) with annotated timeline and key traces (attached).
- Full set of relevant logs and a redacted trace export (kv-cache-trace-jan14.log).
- A mitigation-runbook with configuration recommendations to avoid recurrence.

Requested customer asks
- Please confirm whether you want us to include additional application-level traces (e.g., transaction IDs) that would help correlate occurrences to your business metrics. If yes, share the span IDs or example request IDs and we will prioritize them.

We understand the operational impact and will propose a set of compensatory SLA credits if you'd like to discuss that with our CS team.

Attaching: novaledger-rca-20270122.pdf (preliminary), kv-cache-trace-jan14.log (redacted), mitigation-runbook-20270122.md (draft).

Best,
Olga
Principal Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: NovaLedger — formal root-cause readout, traces, and fix plan (attached)

Jamie / Priya —

Please find the full readout attached. Below are the highlights and the concrete action items we are committing to execute this week.

Root cause (concise)- A race condition in the cache sync coordinator allowed a delayed commit from a stale leader to overwrite KV shard metadata. The delayed commit was triggered by a rare failover path combined with a longer-than-expected GC pause on one host. When the stale metadata was written back, some requests used an inconsistent prefix cache leading to truncated outputs.

Annotated timeline (excerpt)- 2027-01-13 23:38 UTC — leader failover initiated for pool-7C (maintenance window + autoscaler flapping).
- 2027-01-13 23:40–23:55 UTC — several write commits observed to the same shard during leader transition.
- 2027-01-14 00:02 UTC — first customer-reported degradation alert.
- 2027-01-14 01:20 UTC — automated checks flagged KV shard mismatches; temporary routing applied.
- 2027-01-14 02:15 UTC — cold-cache rebuild completed; majority of traffic normalized.

Action items (Redwood ownership) — target completion by 2027-01-20
- Ship a durable fix to the cache coordinator to prevent stale-leader overwrites (Dylan owning; PR in review).
- Harden GC pause detection and failover gating to avoid leader wobble during maintenance (Neha owning).
- Expose a customer-facing knob to force cache reconciliation on demand (Olga owning; docs and API call).
- Offer an audit of NovaLedger routing/config to reduce blast radius for pool-level issues (opt-in).

Compensation and verification
- We will open a credit request for the impacted window and share the calculation by Monday.
- Post-deployment we will run a verification plan with you — a controlled replay of sampled request IDs and end-to-end checks.

Attachments included (again): novaledger-rca-20270122.pdf (finalized), kv-cache-trace-jan14.log (redacted), mitigation-runbook-20270122.md (final).

If you want a short readout call, I can coordinate a 30-minute slot with Dylan and Neha tomorrow. Please propose times.

Regards,
Olga
Principal Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference
